title: Privacy Policy - Rollercoaster.dev

meta.description: Information on data protection and privacy compliance for Rollercoaster.dev.

heading: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Information on data protection and privacy compliance.

intro.text: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website and services.
intro.commitment: We believe in data minimization — we only collect what we need and use it transparently.

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.text: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:
controller.name: Rollercoaster.dev

dataCollection.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We practice data minimization and currently collect minimal information:

websiteUsage.title: Website Usage Data
items: Basic server logs (IP addresses, browser info, pages visited)
GitHub API requests for displaying project status
websiteUsage.purpose: We use minimal server logs for basic functionality and security. We make GitHub API calls to display our project status cards on the homepage.

communication.title: Communication Data
communication.purpose: We use this information solely to respond to your inquiries and provide support.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: We process your personal data based on the following legal grounds under GDPR:

grounds.description: For website analytics and security, where our legitimate interest in operating and improving our service outweighs any potential impact on your privacy.
When you voluntarily provide information by contacting us or creating an account.
When processing is necessary to provide our services to you.

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.intro: We use your personal data only for the following purposes:
purposes: Responding to your inquiries and providing support
Ensuring website security and preventing abuse
dataUse.noSelling: We never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: We use the following third-party services:

github.name: GitHub API (Microsoft Corporation)
github.purpose: Fetching public repository information for project status display
github.dataShared: No personal data shared - we only access public repository information
github.location: United States (adequate protection under EU-US Data Privacy Framework)

hosting.name: Web Hosting Provider
hosting.note: Our hosting provider processes data only as a data processor under our instructions.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.intro: We use minimal client-side storage to enhance your experience:

localStorage.title: Local Storage (Browser Storage)
localStorage.description: We store the following preferences in your browser's local storage:

items.name: theme-intensity
items.purpose: Remembers your theme preference (vibrant or calm)

items.name: preferred-language
items.purpose: Remembers your language choice (English or German)

localStorage.note: This data stays on your device and is not transmitted to our servers.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: We do not currently use any cookies. When we implement user accounts in the future, we will use:

items.name: rd_auth_token (future)
items.purpose: Will maintain your login session when authentication is implemented

noTracking.title: What We Don't Use
items: No analytics cookies that identify individuals

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.intro: We keep your personal data only as long as necessary:
dataRetention.deletion: When data is no longer needed, it is securely deleted from our systems.

yourRights.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
yourRights.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

rights.description: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
Request deletion of your personal data ('right to be forgotten')
Request limitation of how we process your data
Request your data in a portable format
Object to processing based on legitimate interests
Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent

yourRights.exercise: To exercise these rights, contact us at dev{'@'}rollercoaster.dev. We will respond within 30 days.
yourRights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

security.title: Data Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
measures: HTTPS encryption for all data transmission
Access controls and data minimization practices
Secure data storage with encryption at rest
security.breach: In the unlikely event of a data breach affecting your personal data, we will notify you and relevant authorities as required by law.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.text: Some of our service providers (like GitHub) are located outside the European Economic Area. We ensure adequate protection through:
safeguards: EU-US Data Privacy Framework adequacy decisions
Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission
Regular assessment of data protection standards

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.text: Our services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If you believe we have collected such data, please contact us immediately.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the 'last updated' date.
changes.notification: For significant changes, we may also notify you via email if you have an account with us.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us:
contact.response: We aim to respond to all privacy-related inquiries within 2-3 business days.
